title: Saanson Ki Dhun
prompt: Indie-fusion folk-pop with breathy bansuri, mournful sarangi, warm round sub bass and crisp downtempo beats, wistful and quietly hopeful, airy modern production with organic acoustic texture, tender expressive male Hindi vocal with soft female harmonies, warm reverb-washed timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
(softly)
Hawa mein teri sadaa
Door kahin ek raah

[Verse]
Subah ki pehli kiran
Dhoondhe tujhe har gali
Saanson mein basi hai dhun
Jaise koi bansuri

[Pre-Chorus]
[building energy]
Kadam mere chalte rahe
Manzil abhi door sahi

[Chorus]
Saanson ki dhun gungunaa
Raahon mein tu mil jaana
Door kahin ujaala hai
Dil ko wahi le jaana
(le jaana, le jaana)

[Verse 2]
Shaamein dhalein chupke se
Taaron mein likhun main tu
Sarangi si tadap uthe
Jab bhi yaad aaye tu

[Bridge]
[harmonies]
TU HAI MERI RAAH KI ROSHNI
Har mod pe teri hi kami

[Bansuri Interlude]

[Outro]
(softly)
Saanson ki dhun reh jaana
Door se bhi tu sun jaana
